records.description: Texas Rangers traded RHP Yu Darvish to Los Angeles Dodgers for 2B Willie Calhoun, RHP A.J. Alexy and SS Brendon Davis.
Cincinnati Reds traded RHP Dylan Floro, RHP Zach Neal and Future Considerations to Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP James Marinan and RHP Aneurys Zabala.
Baltimore Orioles traded SS Manny Machado to Los Angeles Dodgers for 2B Breyvic Valera, RF Yusniel Diaz, RHP Zach Pop, RHP Dean Kremer and 3B Rylan Bannon.
Minnesota Twins traded 2B Brian Dozier to Los Angeles Dodgers for 2B Logan Forsythe, OF Luke Raley and LHP Devin Smeltzer.
Tampa Bay Rays traded RHP Casey Sadler to Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nathan Witt.
Houston Astros traded 1B Tyler White to Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Andre Scrubb.
Los Angeles Dodgers traded CF Alex Verdugo, C Connor Wong and SS Jeter Downs to Boston Red Sox for RF Mookie Betts, LHP David Price and cash.
Los Angeles Dodgers traded LHP Adam Kolarek and RF Cody Thomas to Oakland Athletics for 3B Sheldon Neuse and RHP Gus Varland.
Washington Nationals traded RHP Max Scherzer and SS Trea Turner to Los Angeles Dodgers for C Keibert Ruiz, RHP Josiah Gray, RHP Gerardo Carrillo and OF Donovan Casey.
Minnesota Twins traded LHP Andrew Vasquez to Los Angeles Dodgers for C Stevie Berman.
Los Angeles Dodgers traded RHP Zach Willeman to Kansas City Royals.
Los Angeles Dodgers traded LF Billy McKinney and OF Zach Reks to Texas Rangers for cash.
Los Angeles Dodgers traded LF Luke Raley to Tampa Bay Rays for RHP Tanner Dodson.
Chicago Cubs traded RHP Chris Martin to Los Angeles Dodgers for 2B Zach McKinstry.
Los Angeles Dodgers traded RHP Mitch White and 2B Alex De Jesus to Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Nick Frasso and LHP Moises Brito.
Miami Marlins traded SS Miguel Rojas to Los Angeles Dodgers for SS Jacob Amaya.
Los Angeles Dodgers traded RHP Andre Jackson to Pittsburgh Pirates for cash.
Los Angeles Dodgers traded 2B Gavin Lux to Cincinnati Reds for CF Mike Sirota and Draft Pick.
Los Angeles Dodgers traded RHP Dustin May to Boston Red Sox for RF James Tibbs III and OF Zach Ehrhard.
